positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Helping fortune 500 companies "outsource" inside the United States while updating my skillset. Already a degreed IT professional with over 15 years experience, I'm currently learning the gambut of .Net or Node js with Angular or React front-ends. Add MongoDB to the stack, and you've got a MEAN stack!

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
For this small construction maintenance company, used a combination of a highly-customized version of CodeIgniter, PHP, mysql, html5, javascript, jquery, JSON, bootstrap, google full calendar, google maps and PHPUnit testing to: 

Develop a tasks and goals system that allowed employees to assign themselves/others objectives with due dates as well as many other requirements including incorporation of a human resources application. 

Design a human resources system that keeps employee, emergency contact, and PTO (paid time off), with individual employee modifications available. 

Build an employee contract system driven by images of pdfs with input boxes on top that the employee and then the employer could fill out and sign. 

Develop web application that tenants of property management companies could use to ask for service requests. 

Return backend api responses for both ios and android application endpoints.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst (Contractor)
positions.description: Project Green Design: From conference room to production line. Developed PIs (Process Instructions) with SIEMENS EBM (Electronic Batch Management) SUITE including the JD Edwards suite and Sql Server for a new pharmaceutical built to produce immunoglobulin. Designed filling operations process based on input from the Belgium plant, local engineers, supervisors and operators. Taught super-users (including managers and operators) how to use EBM and guided them through the process, including OQ (Operational Qualification) testing and validation. Provided solutions and feedback for the MES implementation of the filling process after gathering and documenting input from managers and operators. Acted as an MES Consultant for Documentation—Business Systems Analyst who reviewed documents for completeness and accuracy in preparation for the FDA (US Food and Drug Administration) to be able to accept and later approve the processes.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: Contractor who upgraded small banking and credit union customer applications adding items like Mobile Banking, SMS Text Banking and Pop Money using XML, Unix, VI, SQL Informix, Pivotal, P4 versioning software and a proprietary DB.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
For this small, family-owned and operated manufacturer and distributor of building products, worked as the sole programmer improving web applications.  

Created Customer Service Request using MVC C#, jquery, and knockout js.  App for capturing images on devices and uploading them to server for management approval. 

Created Pricing Management Tool to help upper management determine what prices to charge to make the desired profit margin. 

Using Umbraco CMS, located and added > 200 door images for online selections and printed catalog.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Padgett is a franchisor of small business consulting franchises.  Worked at the head office as a "Jill-of-all-trades" writing custom applications, installing servers/software/databases and 	providing technical support to users and franchisees.  

Maintained and supported software and implemented new features in a proprietary accounting software package written in Powerbulder with a Sybase back-end. One new feature example is the addition of State Unemployment forms for businesses, including all 50 states' forms. This implementation included gathering state requirements, developing the solutions, having franchisees test the forms, and obtaining state approval. Approval is an on-going process as each state may or may/not change requirements yearly. Overcame the issue of some states going to two SUTA (State Unemployment Tax) rates instead of one because the US economy was going through a down-turn. Also designed, tested and deployed installation scripts for this software package using Nullsoft. 

Using Ubuntu,  Apache web server, LDAP, MYSQL, AJAX, PHP, CSS and Javascript,  converted Legacy Program to a Home Office Portal: The portal has a user-based menu, friendly data-entry and related management reports.

Financial Reporting:  Customized balance sheets, income statements, and other financial reports in Thompson Reuters tax and accounting suite to accommodate a customized chart of accounts for different business entities and some state-specific requirements. Supported SQL Server installation for end-users on various operating systems. 

Administration:  Administrator for NetPortal which is a secure, encrypted file exchange used between Home Office and Franchisee.  

Miscellaneous:  Assisted with escalated computer support issues.  Installed cloud backup software on a variety of operating systems:  Win Server 2008 and 2003, Win 7 32- and 64-bit, Win XP Pro.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Reporting to the IT Director in the 4 person IT Department of this building products manufacturer, built a variety of applications and evaluated different kinds of databases including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and MYSQL for price, speed, ease of implementation.  Projects include:  

Intranet-Based Order Entry:  Using PHP, Javascript, AJAX and XML HTTP Request, converted legacy-based order-entry system to create a dynamic, user-friendly intranet-based pricing component.  

Detailed Status Sheet:  Using PHP, Javascript, Pervasive SQL and Mysql, developed a scheduling tool that allowed production and sales see the location of individual items on orders as they moved through the inventory movement system.  Automatically updated items as they moved through the system while allowing users to modify as needed.  Developed system, trained users, modified to implement specific needs and added reports.

Physical Inventory System:  Using PHP, Javascript, Pervasive Sql and Mysql, was Project Lead in building a physical inventory system which  included supervision, determining specs, coding, testing, training, and implementation on this interactive intranet application.

Delivery Ticket Automation, Using PHP, dynamic Javascript , web-based print automation and local print automation via XML dataset, automated the Delivery Ticket System.  Includes download into a local Delphi.exe, with print feature unseen to users.

Automatic Treating System:  Console-based Delphi program that logs into various servers and downloads production data from MS Access tables.  Processes and posts downloaded data for inventory movement transactions and emails users at various sites with links to production reports. 

Reports including Corporate Financial, Accounting, Sales, Production, Payroll, Shipping and Export:  Built intranet-based reports Delphi 5 CGI with Report Builder or PHP scripting with automated PDF builders. 

Data warehousing:  Warehoused data using Delphi 5, PHP, Pervasive SQL and MYSQL.
